needed.evidence: Market stalls and goods are set up on the edge of the road, leaving no clear, safe path for pedestrians.
needed.suggestion: Construct a proper sidewalk on the right side to separate pedestrians from the market stalls and vehicle traffic.

needed.evidence: The entire right side of the street is occupied by a market, with stalls and goods extending to the road edge.
needed.suggestion: Create a designated, enclosed market area on the right side to clear the pedestrian path.

needed.evidence: The footway is uneven, with visible debris and a significant gap or hole near the curb.
needed.suggestion: Repair the broken and uneven sections of the footway on the left side to ensure a safe, continuous path.

needed.evidence: The ground on the right is uneven and cluttered with market goods, creating multiple trip hazards.
needed.suggestion: Level and clear the area on the right side to remove trip hazards for pedestrians.

needed.evidence: There is a high demand for crossing due to shops on both sides, but no marked or purpose-built crossing is present.
needed.suggestion: Install a clearly marked pedestrian crossing at a suitable point to provide a safe place for people to cross the road.

needed.evidence: No kerb ramps are visible as there is no formal crossing facility.
needed.suggestion: As part of installing a new marked crossing, construct dropped kerbs (kerb ramps) at both sides to allow safe access.

needed.evidence: No street lights are visible along the length of the road in any of the frames.
needed.suggestion: Install a series of street lights along the road to improve visibility and safety for both pedestrians and drivers, especially in the evening.
